vision: Privacy-focused social media analytics SaaS platform with unique cross-platform content tracking and smart filtering to prevent data overwhelm

target_audience.primary: Marketing agencies and social media managers in Belgium and Europe who manage multiple clients and need cross-platform analytics
secondary: Small business owners managing their own social media presence
Content creators tracking performance across TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook
Freelance social media consultants with multiple clients

phases.name: Foundation / MVP
phases.description: Core infrastructure, authentication, and primary platform integrations (Instagram + TikTok) with the key differentiator: cross-platform content correlation

milestones.title: Users can register and login securely
milestones.description: Complete authentication flow with secure session management and environment-based configuration

milestones.title: Dashboard shows real Instagram analytics
milestones.description: Users can connect Instagram account and view engagement metrics, follower growth, and post performance

milestones.title: TikTok analytics are accessible
milestones.description: TikTok integration working via OAuth or CSV import with core metrics displayed

milestones.title: Cross-platform content tracking works
milestones.description: Users can link same content across TikTok and Instagram and see comparative performance - the key differentiator

milestones.title: Agencies can manage multiple clients
milestones.description: Multi-tenant architecture allows agencies to manage separate client accounts with isolated data

phases.name: Enhancement
phases.description: Expand platform coverage, add content planning tools, smart filtering, and white-label capabilities to differentiate from competitors

milestones.title: Facebook analytics integrated
milestones.description: Complete Meta Graph API integration covering both Instagram and Facebook with unified dashboard

milestones.title: Content planning workflow available
milestones.description: Users can plan content with calendar, AI hashtag suggestions, and best time recommendations

milestones.title: Smart filtering prevents data overwhelm
milestones.description: Users see only relevant insights with configurable filters and alert thresholds

milestones.title: Agencies can white-label reports
milestones.description: Custom branding options for agency client reports and dashboards

phases.name: Scale / Growth
phases.description: Performance optimization, additional platforms, automated reporting, and team collaboration to support growth

milestones.title: YouTube Shorts analytics available
milestones.description: YouTube integration complete, enabling full short-form video tracking across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

milestones.title: Automated client reports delivered
milestones.description: PDF/email reports automatically generated and sent to clients on schedule

milestones.title: Platform is production-ready at scale
milestones.description: Redis caching, job queues, monitoring, and CI/CD ensure reliable operation under load

phases.name: Future / Vision
phases.description: Long-term features for market expansion, advanced AI capabilities, and enterprise functionality

milestones.title: Full B2B platform support
milestones.description: LinkedIn integration enables complete B2B social media analytics offering

milestones.title: AI-powered content intelligence
milestones.description: AI generates content suggestions, sentiment analysis, and performance predictions

features.title: User Authentication System
features.description: Complete user registration, login, password reset, and session management with secure token handling. Includes email verification and OAuth foundation for social logins.
features.rationale: Essential foundation for any SaaS. Must be secure and reliable before any other features can be built. Addresses the current gap of 'No user registration/authentication flow'.
acceptance_criteria: Users can register with email and password
Email verification is sent and required for activation
Users can login and receive secure session token
Password reset flow works via email link
Sessions expire after configured timeout
Failed login attempts are rate-limited
user_stories: As a new user, I want to register for an account so that I can access the analytics platform
As a returning user, I want to login securely so that I can view my analytics data
As a forgetful user, I want to reset my password so that I can regain access to my account

features.title: Analytics Dashboard UI
features.description: Modern, responsive dashboard interface with customizable widgets showing key metrics: total reach, engagement rate, follower growth, and top performing content. Built with Vue.js/Alpine.js and TailwindCSS.
features.rationale: The dashboard is the core user interface. Must be clean and simple to differentiate from overwhelming enterprise tools. Directly addresses competitor pain points about complex interfaces (Hootsuite, Sprout Social).
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard loads in under 2 seconds
Key metrics are displayed in clear, visual widgets
Time-range filters work (today, 7d, 30d, 90d, custom)
Platform filters toggle visibility of different data sources
Dashboard is fully responsive for mobile viewing
Users can customize which widgets are visible
user_stories: As a social media manager, I want to see my key metrics at a glance so that I can quickly assess performance
As an agency owner, I want a clean interface so that I don't get overwhelmed by data
As a mobile user, I want to check performance on my phone so that I can monitor accounts on the go

features.title: Instagram Graph API Integration
features.description: Complete Instagram Business/Creator account integration via Meta Graph API. Fetches profile insights, media insights, stories performance, and audience demographics with automated daily syncing.
features.rationale: Instagram is the easiest platform to integrate (free API, good documentation) and most requested by target audience. Foundation for cross-platform tracking. Most competitors have this but lack depth in cross-platform comparison.
acceptance_criteria: OAuth flow successfully connects Instagram Business accounts
Profile metrics sync: followers, reach, impressions, profile views
Media metrics sync: likes, comments, shares, saves, engagement rate
Stories metrics are captured: reach, impressions, exits, replies
Data syncs automatically every 15-30 minutes for recent posts
Token refresh works automatically before expiration
user_stories: As a social media manager, I want to connect my Instagram account so that I can track its performance
As a content creator, I want to see engagement metrics for each post so that I can understand what content works
As an agency, I want to connect client Instagram accounts so that I can report on their performance

features.title: TikTok Analytics Integration
features.description: TikTok integration via TikTok Login Kit OAuth with CSV import fallback for analytics data. Supports video views, likes, comments, shares, follower growth, and video completion rates.
features.rationale: TikTok is critical for target audience but has limited API access. CSV import workaround addresses this gap. Competitors like Buffer and Hootsuite have weak TikTok support - this is a major opportunity.
acceptance_criteria: TikTok OAuth successfully connects creator accounts
CSV import parses TikTok analytics exports correctly
Video metrics display: views, likes, comments, shares, saves
Account metrics show: followers, following, total videos
Video completion rate and average watch time are tracked
Clear status indicator shows if data is from API or CSV
user_stories: As a TikTok creator, I want to see my video performance in SocialBit so that I have unified analytics
As a content creator, I want to import TikTok CSV exports so that I can track performance even without API access
As an agency, I want robust TikTok analytics so that I can report on this growing platform

features.title: Cross-Platform Content Groups
features.description: Unique feature allowing users to link the same piece of content across different platforms (e.g., 1 TikTok = 1 Instagram Reel = 1 YouTube Short) and view comparative performance analytics in a unified view.
features.rationale: This is SocialBit's KEY DIFFERENTIATOR. No competitor offers this feature. Directly addresses a major market gap identified in competitor analysis. Agencies frequently repurpose content and need to compare performance.
acceptance_criteria: Users can create content groups and add posts from different platforms
Manual linking UI allows easy post selection and grouping
Comparative view shows side-by-side metrics for linked content
Cross-platform performance scoring calculates relative success
Users can name and organize content groups
Dashboard highlights top-performing content groups
user_stories: As a content creator, I want to link my TikTok and Instagram posts so that I can see which platform performs better
As an agency, I want to compare content performance across platforms so that I can advise clients on platform strategy
As a marketer, I want to identify which platforms work best for different content types so that I can optimize distribution

features.title: Multi-Tenant Client Management
features.description: Agency-focused multi-tenant architecture allowing one account to manage multiple client accounts with isolated data, separate social connections, and role-based access control.
features.rationale: Target audience is marketing agencies managing multiple clients. Must support isolated client data and easy switching. Addresses Buffer's pain point about pricing per client and provides agency-friendly model.
acceptance_criteria: Agency owner can create multiple client accounts
Each client has isolated data and social connections
Client switcher allows easy navigation between accounts
Role-based access: admin, editor, viewer permissions
Billing is consolidated at agency level
Client data can be exported individually
user_stories: As an agency owner, I want to manage all my clients from one account so that I don't need multiple logins
As an agency, I want client data to be isolated so that there's no risk of cross-contamination
As an agency manager, I want to give team members limited access so that they can only view certain clients

features.title: Affordable Agency Pricing Model
features.description: Tiered pricing structure (€29-199/mo) with agency-friendly model that includes multiple clients per plan, avoiding the per-user pricing trap that makes competitors expensive.
features.rationale: Major differentiator from Hootsuite ($99+/mo) and Sprout Social ($249+/mo). Competitor analysis shows high pricing is the #1 pain point. Target market is price-sensitive SMBs and small agencies.
acceptance_criteria: Starter plan (€29/mo): 1 client, 3 platforms
Professional plan (€79/mo): 5 clients, all platforms
Agency plan (€199/mo): 20 clients, white-label
Clear feature comparison on pricing page
Monthly and annual billing options
Trial period available without credit card
user_stories: As a freelancer, I want affordable pricing so that analytics don't eat into my margins
As a small agency, I want to pay per client tier, not per user so that I can grow my team affordably
As a business owner, I want to try before buying so that I can evaluate if SocialBit meets my needs

features.title: Security Hardening
features.description: Move all secrets to environment variables, implement encrypted token storage, add proper error logging, and set up security monitoring. Essential technical debt cleanup.
features.rationale: Current prototype has hardcoded credentials and visible API secrets. Must be fixed before any production deployment. Critical for trust with agency clients handling sensitive data.
acceptance_criteria: All API keys and secrets are in .env file
OAuth tokens are encrypted in database
Error logging is set up with proper monitoring
No secrets visible in code or version control
Security headers are properly configured
Rate limiting protects against abuse
user_stories: As a platform operator, I want secrets properly secured so that there's no risk of data breach
As an agency client, I want my social media tokens encrypted so that my accounts are protected
As a developer, I want proper error logging so that I can debug issues without exposing sensitive data

features.title: Facebook Page Analytics Integration
features.description: Extend Meta Graph API integration to include Facebook Pages with page insights, post performance, video analytics, and audience demographics.
features.rationale: Many agencies manage both Instagram and Facebook for clients. Leverages same Meta Graph API infrastructure. Completes the Meta ecosystem coverage for comprehensive social analytics.
acceptance_criteria: Facebook Pages can be connected via existing Meta OAuth
Page insights sync: likes, reach, impressions, engagement
Post metrics display: reactions, comments, shares, clicks
Video metrics: views, watch time, retention
Audience demographics available
Cross-platform groups support Facebook posts
user_stories: As an agency, I want to track Facebook alongside Instagram so that I have complete Meta analytics
As a business, I want to see my Facebook Page performance so that I can optimize my content strategy
As a marketer, I want to compare Facebook and Instagram performance so that I know where to focus

features.title: Content Calendar & Planning
features.description: Visual content calendar showing scheduled and published posts across all platforms. Includes drag-and-drop planning, content ideas storage, and publish date management.
features.rationale: Content planning is a core workflow for target audience. Addresses the 'Content calendar/planning tool missing' gap. Differentiates from pure analytics tools by adding planning capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: Calendar view shows all platforms in unified view
Users can create content ideas and schedule them
Drag-and-drop rescheduling works
Color coding distinguishes platforms
Past posts show with their actual performance
Mobile-friendly calendar view
user_stories: As a content creator, I want to plan my content calendar so that I maintain consistent posting
As an agency, I want to see all client content in one calendar so that I can manage workload
As a social media manager, I want to store content ideas so that I never run out of things to post

features.title: AI-Powered Hashtag Suggestions
features.description: Integration with RiteKit or Ayrshare API to provide platform-specific hashtag recommendations, trending hashtags, and hashtag performance tracking.
features.rationale: Hashtag optimization is key to content discovery. Part of the 'Content planning with AI-powered hashtag suggestions' differentiator. Adds value beyond pure analytics.
acceptance_criteria: Users can input a keyword and get hashtag suggestions
Suggestions are platform-specific (TikTok vs Instagram vs Facebook)
Trending hashtags are highlighted with popularity scores
Users can save favorite hashtag sets
Hashtag performance is tracked over time
Integration handles API rate limits gracefully
user_stories: As a content creator, I want hashtag suggestions so that my posts reach more people
As a marketer, I want to know trending hashtags so that I can capitalize on viral trends
As an agency, I want to track hashtag performance so that I can optimize client content

features.title: Best Time to Post Analysis
features.description: Analyze historical post performance to identify optimal posting times for each platform, considering audience activity patterns and engagement trends.
features.rationale: Helps users maximize content reach without guesswork. Metricool offers this - need feature parity. Valuable for agencies optimizing client content strategy.
acceptance_criteria: Analysis shows optimal posting times by day of week
Recommendations are platform-specific
Based on actual historical performance data
Visual heatmap shows engagement patterns
Recommendations update as more data is collected
Users can filter by content type
user_stories: As a content creator, I want to know the best time to post so that I maximize engagement
As an agency, I want data-driven posting recommendations so that I can optimize client schedules
As a marketer, I want to understand my audience's active hours so that I post when they're online

features.title: Smart Filtering & Alert System
features.description: Configurable filtering system that highlights important changes and hides noise. Includes alert thresholds for significant metric changes, saved filter presets, and progressive disclosure UI.
features.rationale: Key differentiator addressing 'information overload' pain point. Competitors show all data without smart filtering. Target audience specifically wants to avoid overwhelm from enterprise tools.
acceptance_criteria: Users can set alert thresholds for metric changes
Alerts trigger for significant performance changes (e.g., +50% engagement)
Dashboard defaults to essential metrics only
Progressive disclosure allows drilling into details
Filter presets can be saved (e.g., 'Executive Summary')
Email/push notifications for critical alerts
user_stories: As a busy manager, I want to see only what matters so that I'm not overwhelmed by data
As an agency owner, I want alerts for significant changes so that I can react quickly
As a social media manager, I want to save my preferred view so that I don't reconfigure filters daily

features.title: White-Label Agency Branding
features.description: Allow agencies to customize the platform with their own logo, colors, and domain for client-facing reports and dashboards. Available in Agency tier.
features.rationale: Major differentiator for agency market. Buffer and Later don't offer this in lower tiers. Enables agencies to present SocialBit as their own tool to clients.
acceptance_criteria: Agencies can upload custom logo and favicon
Brand colors are customizable
Custom domain/subdomain support
Email notifications use agency branding
Client-facing reports show agency branding only
Original SocialBit branding is hidden in white-label mode
user_stories: As an agency, I want to white-label the platform so that clients see my brand
As a consultant, I want custom branding on reports so that I maintain professional image
As an agency owner, I want a custom domain so that clients access my branded portal

features.title: Website Analytics Integration (Fathom)
features.description: Integration with Fathom Analytics API for privacy-focused website tracking. Shows pageviews, unique visitors, top pages, referrers, and correlates with social media traffic.
features.rationale: Privacy-focused approach differentiates from competitors using GA4. Fathom is GDPR-compliant with simple API. Addresses the 'Privacy concerns with traditional analytics' pain point.
acceptance_criteria: Users can connect Fathom Analytics account
Website metrics display: pageviews, unique visitors, bounce rate
Top pages and referrers are shown
Social media referral traffic is highlighted
Real-time visitor count available
GDPR compliance messaging is clear
user_stories: As a privacy-conscious business, I want Fathom integration so that I'm GDPR compliant
As a marketer, I want to see website traffic alongside social metrics so that I understand the full funnel
As an agency, I want to correlate social posts with website visits so that I can prove ROI

features.title: Multi-Language Support
features.description: Localization for Dutch, English, and French languages. All UI elements, notifications, and reports are translatable.
features.rationale: Target market is Belgium and Europe where multiple languages are spoken. Differentiator for European-focused positioning. Improves accessibility for non-English speakers.
acceptance_criteria: UI supports Dutch, English, and French
Language switcher is easily accessible
All dashboard text is translated
Email notifications respect language preference
Reports can be generated in preferred language
Date and number formats adapt to locale
user_stories: As a Dutch-speaking user, I want the interface in my language so that I can work more efficiently
As an agency, I want reports in client's preferred language so that they understand the data
As a Belgian user, I want French support so that I can use my native language

features.title: YouTube Analytics Integration
features.description: Integration with YouTube Analytics API for video performance tracking. Includes views, watch time, subscriber growth, and completion rates for YouTube Shorts.
features.rationale: Completes the short-form video trifecta (TikTok, Reels, Shorts). YouTube is part of the target audience's platform mix. Enables complete cross-platform content comparison.
acceptance_criteria: YouTube channel can be connected via Google OAuth
Video metrics sync: views, watch time, likes, comments
Subscriber growth is tracked
YouTube Shorts are identified and tracked separately
YouTube posts can be added to cross-platform content groups
Revenue metrics available for monetized channels
user_stories: As a content creator, I want YouTube analytics so that I can track all my video platforms
As an agency, I want to compare Shorts performance with TikTok and Reels so that I can advise on platform strategy
As a YouTuber, I want watch time analytics so that I can optimize video length

features.title: Automated PDF Report Generation
features.description: Generate professional PDF reports automatically on schedule (weekly/monthly). Include key metrics, top content, growth trends, and send via email to clients.
features.rationale: Agencies need to report to clients regularly. Manual reporting is time-consuming. Addresses 'Generate client reports without information overload' goal from discovery.
acceptance_criteria: Reports can be scheduled (weekly, monthly)
PDF includes key metrics, charts, and top content
White-label branding applied automatically
Reports are emailed to configured recipients
Report templates are customizable
Historical reports are archived and accessible
user_stories: As an agency, I want automated reports so that I save time on manual reporting
As a client, I want clear monthly reports so that I understand my social performance
As a consultant, I want professional PDF reports so that I look polished to clients

features.title: Custom Report Builder
features.description: Drag-and-drop report builder allowing users to select specific metrics, charts, and time ranges for custom reports tailored to client needs.
features.rationale: Addresses Metricool pain point about limited report customization. Agencies have different reporting needs per client. Empowers users to create exactly what they need.
acceptance_criteria: Drag-and-drop interface for building reports
All available metrics can be added to reports
Multiple chart types are supported
Custom text and commentary can be added
Report templates can be saved and reused
Preview before generating final report
user_stories: As an agency, I want custom reports so that each client gets relevant metrics
As a marketer, I want to choose which charts to include so that reports tell the right story
As a consultant, I want to save report templates so that I can reuse them for similar clients

features.title: Team Collaboration Features
features.description: Enable multiple team members to work on the same account with comments, task assignments, and activity feeds for collaborative social media management.
features.rationale: Agencies have teams working on accounts. Supports growth from solo users to teams. Feature parity with Hootsuite's team collaboration.
acceptance_criteria: Multiple team members can access same account
Comments can be added to posts and analytics
Activity feed shows team actions
Task assignments for content review
Approval workflows for scheduled content
Per-user permissions and access levels
user_stories: As an agency manager, I want my team to collaborate so that we work efficiently
As a team member, I want to see what others are working on so that we don't duplicate effort
As an account owner, I want approval workflows so that nothing goes out without review

features.title: Redis Caching Layer
features.description: Implement Redis for application caching, session storage, and job queue management. Improves dashboard response time and handles API rate limits gracefully.
features.rationale: Technical foundation for scaling. Essential for meeting <2s response time target. Enables smart API polling and rate limit management.
acceptance_criteria: Redis is configured on Plesk infrastructure
Dashboard queries are cached (5-15 minute TTL)
Session storage uses Redis
Cache invalidation works correctly on new data
Dashboard loads consistently under 2 seconds
Cache hit rates are monitored
user_stories: As a user, I want fast dashboard loading so that I can check metrics quickly
As a platform operator, I want efficient caching so that API costs stay low
As a developer, I want reliable session storage so that users stay logged in

features.title: Background Job Queue System
features.description: Laravel Queue or similar for handling API polling, data syncing, report generation, and email sending in background jobs with retry logic and failure handling.
features.rationale: Essential for reliable API integration and scaling. Prevents request timeouts on large operations. Enables smart polling without blocking user requests.
acceptance_criteria: Queue workers process jobs reliably
Failed jobs are retried with exponential backoff
Job status is visible in admin dashboard
Email and report generation run asynchronously
API rate limits are respected via queued requests
Dead letter queue handles persistent failures
user_stories: As a user, I want background syncing so that my dashboard is always up to date
As a platform operator, I want reliable job processing so that data syncs don't fail silently
As an agency, I want reports generated in background so that I can continue working

features.title: Error Logging & Monitoring
features.description: Comprehensive error logging, performance monitoring, and alerting for production issues. Integration with monitoring tools for uptime and performance tracking.
features.rationale: Essential for production reliability. Currently missing proper error logging setup. Required for maintaining >99.5% uptime target.
acceptance_criteria: All errors are logged with context and stack traces
Performance metrics are tracked (response times, memory)
Alerts trigger for high error rates or slow responses
Uptime monitoring is configured
Log aggregation enables easy debugging
Sensitive data is redacted from logs
user_stories: As a developer, I want error logs so that I can debug issues quickly
As a platform operator, I want uptime monitoring so that I know when things break
As a user, I want reliable service so that my analytics are always available

features.title: CI/CD Pipeline
features.description: Automated deployment pipeline with testing, staging environment, and production deployment to Plesk infrastructure.
features.rationale: Essential for sustainable development velocity. Reduces deployment risk and enables frequent releases. Currently missing from technical infrastructure.
acceptance_criteria: Commits trigger automated test suite
Staging deployment is automatic on merge to develop
Production deployment requires approval
Rollback mechanism is available
Database migrations run automatically
Zero-downtime deployments work correctly
user_stories: As a developer, I want automated deployments so that I can ship features faster
As a platform operator, I want staging environment so that I can test before production
As a developer, I want automated tests so that I catch bugs before deployment

features.title: LinkedIn Analytics Integration
features.description: Integration with LinkedIn Marketing API for company page and post analytics. Enables B2B-focused agencies to track LinkedIn performance alongside other platforms.
features.rationale: Expands platform coverage to B2B market. LinkedIn is important for business-focused content. Completes professional social media coverage.
acceptance_criteria: LinkedIn company pages can be connected
Post impressions, engagement, and clicks are tracked
Follower analytics and demographics available
LinkedIn posts can join cross-platform content groups
B2B-specific metrics are highlighted
Token refresh works automatically
user_stories: As a B2B agency, I want LinkedIn analytics so that I can serve corporate clients
As a professional, I want to track LinkedIn alongside other platforms so that I have complete visibility
As a marketer, I want to compare LinkedIn with Instagram so that I know which works for B2B content

features.title: Twitter/X Analytics Integration
features.description: Integration with Twitter/X API v2 for tweet analytics and account metrics. Note: Twitter API is expensive ($100-5000/mo), so this is lower priority.
features.rationale: Twitter remains important for some clients despite declining usage. API cost is a significant barrier. Only worth implementing if customer demand justifies cost.
acceptance_criteria: Twitter accounts can be connected
Tweet impressions, engagement, and retweets tracked
Follower growth analytics available
Tweets can join cross-platform content groups
API cost is acceptable for business model
Rate limits are handled gracefully
user_stories: As a brand manager, I want Twitter analytics so that I can track our presence there
As an agency, I want complete platform coverage so that clients don't need multiple tools
As a marketer, I want to compare Twitter with other platforms so that I understand performance

features.title: Self-Hosted Deployment Option
features.description: Docker-based self-hosted deployment option for agencies wanting complete data ownership. Includes setup documentation and update mechanism.
features.rationale: Differentiator for privacy-conscious enterprises. Addresses data sovereignty concerns. Niche but valuable for security-focused clients.
acceptance_criteria: Docker compose file enables single-command setup
Comprehensive installation documentation
Automatic update mechanism available
Data migration tools for moving to/from cloud
Support for common infrastructure (AWS, Azure, bare metal)
License model supports self-hosting
user_stories: As a privacy-focused agency, I want self-hosting so that client data never leaves my infrastructure
As an enterprise, I want data sovereignty so that I comply with internal policies
As a technical agency, I want control over infrastructure so that I can customize deployment

features.title: Competitor Tracking & Benchmarking
features.description: Allow users to track public competitor accounts and benchmark their performance against competitors. Show relative growth and engagement comparisons.
features.rationale: Valuable for agencies advising clients on competitive positioning. Metricool offers competitor analysis. Future differentiator for advanced analytics.
acceptance_criteria: Users can add competitor accounts to track
Public metrics are collected (followers, engagement rates)
Benchmark charts compare user vs competitors
Growth rate comparisons are available
Competitor content themes are analyzed
Alerts for significant competitor changes
user_stories: As a brand manager, I want to track competitors so that I know how we compare
As an agency, I want competitive benchmarks so that I can advise clients on their position
As a marketer, I want to learn from competitor success so that I can improve our strategy

features.title: AI Content Suggestions
features.description: AI-powered analysis of top-performing content to suggest content topics, caption styles, and posting strategies based on historical performance patterns.
features.rationale: Future innovation opportunity. AI is differentiator in crowded market. Adds value by turning analytics into actionable recommendations.
acceptance_criteria: AI analyzes top-performing content patterns
Content topic suggestions based on what works
Caption style recommendations
Posting frequency optimization suggestions
Trend predictions for upcoming topics
Confidence scores on recommendations
user_stories: As a content creator, I want AI suggestions so that I create more engaging content
As an agency, I want data-driven recommendations so that I can advise clients confidently
As a marketer, I want to understand what works so that I can replicate success

features.title: Google Analytics 4 Integration
features.description: Integration with GA4 Data API for comprehensive website analytics alongside privacy-focused Fathom option. Provides deeper website insights for power users.
features.rationale: GA4 is industry standard with more data than Fathom. Some clients will prefer comprehensive analytics over privacy focus. Offering both gives flexibility.
acceptance_criteria: GA4 properties can be connected via Google OAuth
Sessions, users, pageviews are synced
Traffic sources and campaign data available
Conversion tracking integration
Custom events can be displayed
Clear privacy trade-off messaging
user_stories: As a power user, I want GA4 integration so that I have comprehensive website data
As an agency, I want to offer both GA4 and Fathom so that clients can choose
As a marketer, I want conversion tracking so that I can measure social media ROI
